name: K*A*O*R*I
source:
Souji, the writer for an art magazine can't keep up with the mysterious Ghostwriter who publishes articles under his name. Can the Ghostwriter resolve your past? 

[From [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]Official site[/url]]
translation:
艺术杂志撰稿人宗司始终无法跟上神秘代笔人的脚步。对方以他的名义发表文章。这个代笔人能够解开你的过去吗？

[摘自[url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]官方网站[/url]]
